description: JVM host ABI slice (ISSUE-0100). JVM-only multi-module fixtures: each fixture writes its 'modules' (relative .deal paths, including the host .d.deal declarations) plus 'entry' under a temp project root, and — when the fixture declares 'hosts' — a real deal.json whose externals map wires each raw host import path to its declaration (the spec manifest form). The runner then executes the real whole-project pipeline: CompilationOrchestrator with Backend.JVM (externals-gated host resolution, module discovery, signature extraction, dependency ordering, name resolution, type checking, per-module JvmBackend codegen) → the host implementation classes are compiled with javac together with every emitted .java artifact plus a runner class → java executes the emitted artifacts (the harness fails a fixture whose parser/checker/module-discovery yields no compile, whose codegen leaves no artifact, whose host implementation is missing, or whose JVM execution is bypassed). ISSUE-0106 migrates every fixture to the v1.2 module shape: entry modules export non-async main(): null (the v1.2 entry gate) and the v1.1 module-level executable statements are wrapped inside main() so the load-time and boundary checks stay observable. Covered host ABI forms (spec-v1.2 §Modules, declarations, standard library, and host ABI + §JVM value mapping): declared export exposure through load-time-validated reflective wrappers, missing declared exports as load-time E8011 errors, extra host exports ignored, sync return boundary checks (E8010 for wrong runtime kinds, including Java null crossing a non-nullable boundary — the spec's no-unvalidated-null rule), nullable returns accepting Java null as the DEAL null sentinel, the null return boundary (E8010 for a non-null host result), the int safe-range return boundary (E8004), the ISSUE-0106 v1.2 boundary string validation at the host return boundary (E8010 for sync returns — plain and nullable string descriptors — and E8001 for async completion values when the returned java.lang.String carries unpaired UTF-16 surrogate code units, spec-v1.2 §String escapes and Unicode / §JVM value mapping), host function parameter adaptation (declared primitive/string/nullable parameters arriving as their JVM mappings), async host operation shape checks (E8010 for a non-operation), async completion value checks (E8001 at the await site, with the spec-permitting blocking JVM await lowering), and one frontend E2009 compile-error gate rejected before any backend. ISSUE-0303 (jvm-v12-host-abi-completion) extends the slice to the array/function/class/prewrapped shapes: declared array parameters/returns flow on the shared $DealRt wrappers with E8010 at the call boundary (array carrier/element mismatches included, never a masking read-site error), function-typed parameters arrive as the typed $DealRt wrapper (the host invokes through the typed invoke; no lambda conversion), function-typed returns are never wrapped (a raw value fails E8010, a byte-equal descriptor passes), declared host classes synthesize shared $DealRt records with canonical externals identity and the preserved defaults-map construction seam (E8007 for an extra provided name), the pre-wrapped pair executes against declared-shape hosts whose declared-descriptor enforcement raises E8010 on the junk return, and declared host-class ARRAY parameters/returns execute on the shared per-class $HostArr$ __RefArray carrier (ISSUE-0570 acceptance remediation — the import-time E6000 is removed): plain and nullable-element ServerConfig[] literals and host-returned carriers cross the boundary with the D2 checks (E8010 parameter/return mismatch on carrier and wrong-kind element failures, the pinned nominal E8001 for a foreign-identity class element, and the load-time signature check matching the declared $HostArr$ carrier).
